task.instructions: Using matplotlib, read product_sales.csv, which contains columns product, quarter, and sales. Draw a grouped bar chart of sales by quarter, one group per product with two adjacent bars (one per quarter) inside each group, using the colors '#1f77b4' for Q1 and '#ff7f0e' for Q2. Print the sales value above each bar in black text with font size 9, formatted with no decimals. Label the x-axis 'Product', the y-axis 'Sales', and give the figure the title 'Product Sales by Quarter'. Add a legend identifying Q1 and Q2, placed in the upper right corner but not covering any bars. Save the figure to figure.png with a figure size of 9 by 6 inches.

function.arguments:
{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_chart.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('product_sales.csv')

# Get unique products and quarters
products = df['product'].unique()
quarters = ['Q1', 'Q2']

# Set up the figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6))

# Colors for Q1 and Q2
color_q1 = '#1f77b4'
color_q2 = '#ff7f0e'

# Calculate bar positions
bar_width = 0.35
x_positions = range(len(products))

# Create grouped bars
for i, product in enumerate(products):
    product_data = df[df['product'] == product]
    q1_sales = product_data[product_data['quarter'] == 'Q1']['sales'].values[0]
    q2_sales = product_data[product_data['quarter'] == 'Q2']['sales'].values[0]
    
    # Position bars
    bar1 = ax.bar(i - bar_width/2, q1_sales, bar_width, color=color_q1, label='Q1')
    bar2 = ax.bar(i + bar_width/2, q2_sales, bar_width, color=color_q2, label='Q2')
    
    # Add sales value above each bar
    ax.text(bar1[0].get_x() + bar1[0].get_width()/2, 
            bar1[0].get_height() + 2, 
            f'{int(q1_sales)}', 
            ha='center', va='bottom', 
            color='black', fontsize=9)
    
    ax.text(bar2[0].get_x() + bar2[0].get_width()/2, 
            bar2[0].get_height() + 2, 
            f'{int(q2_sales)}', 
            ha='center', va='bottom', 
            color='black', fontsize=9)

# Set x-axis labels
ax.set_xticks(x_positions)
ax.set_xticklabels(products)

# Set axis labels and title
ax.set_xlabel('Product')
ax.set_ylabel('Sales')
ax.set_title('Product Sales by Quarter')

# Add legend in upper right corner
ax.legend(loc='upper right')

# Save the figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}
